title: Hold an environment protection licence for listed activities
what: Hold an environment protection licence (or authorisation) before carrying on an activity the state lists, such as large manufacturing, waste, extractive or energy activities, and meet its conditions.

sources.title: Environment Protection Act 1997 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 42(1) (current republication (R70, from 16 November 2025; Environment Protection Act 1997 | Acts))
sources.quote: (1) A person must not conduct an activity listed in schedule 1 as a class A activity unless the person holds an environmental authorisation in relation to that activity.

administration.note: Issues the licences and enforces them.

sources.title: Environment Protection Act 1997 (ACT)
sources.locator: dictionary, definition of authority (current republication (R70, from 16 November 2025; Environment Protection Act 1997 | Acts))
sources.quote: authority means the Environment Protection Authority under section 11

triggers.note: When the business carries on an activity in the state's list (a schedule to the Act or regulations).

reach.condition: if it carries on an activity the state lists as needing an environment protection licence
reach.note: Any business carrying on a listed activity (such as large manufacturing, waste, extractive, energy and intensive agriculture activities); the lists differ by state and are not yet coded class by class.

sources.title: Environment Protection Act 1997 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 42(1) (current republication (R70, from 16 November 2025; Environment Protection Act 1997 | Acts))
sources.quote: (1) A person must not conduct an activity listed in schedule 1 as a class A activity unless the person holds an environmental authorisation in relation to that activity.

assessment.summary: Businesses carrying on the activities a state lists (large manufacturing, waste, extractive, energy and similar) need an environment protection licence, with conditions, monitoring and fees, before and while operating.

marks.reason: A licence is needed before the listed activities can start.
Licence conditions, monitoring, reporting and annual fees add ongoing cost.

assessment.confidence_note: Marked from the licence's design against the framework's guide; the environmental benefit is not counted by the framework.
